# Tailrocks: macOS Visual Regression

`tailrocks-macos-visual-regression` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-macos-visual-regression)

Compare current native macOS running-window captures against one approved baseline package with environment, structural-region, and pixel-budget gates. Read-only on project and baseline; never freezes or approves design.
